**The problem.** What you were trying to do, and what stopped you or made it worse.

**Where the documents stand.** Does SYSTEM_SPEC, DATA_CONTRACTS or OPERATIONS already decide this? If a full-release feature is what you want (OPERATIONS §3 lists them), say so; those are planned, not forgotten.

**What you propose.** One concrete behavior. If it changes a normative document, it will need a decision record.
